title: "About Me"

### Hi, I'm Ismaël Tchinda Ngueyong

I am an applied mathematician and R&D engineer who specializes in translating complex physical phenomena into high-performance, data-driven software. I build systems that live at the intersection of rigorous mathematical theory, scientific computing, and modern artificial intelligence.

### Bridging Theory and Production

My foundational background is rooted in physics, with early graduate studies at the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) and Université Paris-Saclay. I transitioned into numerical analysis, culminating in a Ph.D. and a postdoctoral fellowship in mathematical modeling at Université Laval. 

While I love the rigor of academic research, my true passion lies in building practical, scalable tools for industry. I continuously expand my toolkit to solve dynamic business and engineering challenges, integrating formal coursework in data processing and financial engineering at ÉTS Montréal into my modeling workflows.

### My Engineering Toolkit

I approach software architecture with an underlying focus on calculus, optimization, and linear algebra. My core technical domains include:

*   **High-Performance Scientific Computing:** Designing custom, scalable C++ libraries (like `CFEM++`) for multiphysics finite element simulations, leveraging tools like PETSc and OpenMP.
*   **Algorithm & Software Development:** Engineering open-source numerical solvers, such as the `PyOdys` Python package for ordinary differential equations.
*   **Hybrid AI Systems:** Combining classical computational fluid dynamics (including CutFEM and level-set methods) with Deep Learning frameworks like PyTorch to construct predictive models, digital twins, and custom machine learning engines from scratch.

### Beyond the Code

Writing clean C++ or optimizing a neural network backpropagation algorithm is only half the job; the other half is communication. Through my experience lecturing at institutions like Cégep de La Pocatière and Collège du Soleil, and acting as a technical consultant, I have honed the ability to break down highly dense mathematical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse teams. I am fully bilingual, collaborating seamlessly in both French and English.
